NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION (FUNCTIONS)
RULES, 1983 (Amendments)
[Gazette of N.-W. F. P., Extraordinary, 9th December, 1984]
No. SORI (S & GAD) 1-99/73.-In exercise of the powers
conferred by section 10 of the North-West Frontier Province Public Service
Commission Ordinance, 1978 (N.-W. F. P. Ordinance XI of 1978), the Government
of the North-West Frontier Province, is pleased to direct that in the
North-West Frontier Province Public Service Commission (Functions) Rules, 1983,
the following further amendments shall be made, namely :----
1. In rule 2, in clause (h), for the word "the", the
word "a" shall be substituted.
2. In rule 3, in clause (a), for the words, figures and comma
"in Scales 16 to 20, except those specified in the Schedule", the
words and letters "specified in Schedule A, except those specified in
Schedule B shall be substituted.
3. The existing Schedule shall be numbered as "Schedule
B" and before "Schedule B", so numbered, the following new
"Schedule A" shall be inserted, namely
